samir: Kickoff: proposing a long-running playbook to carve the "request-affinity" pieces out of runtime into a tiny placement-service. Goal: make runtime single-purpose and reduce hotpath GC pauses.
frances: Sounds reasonable. Main question: who owns affinity metadata and where does the authoritative mapping live during cutover?
kai: My vote: placement-service will be authoritative for mapping during migration; runtime will consult a ReadHint and cache locally with a short TTL. We'll avoid double-writes by making placement the single-writer for 8 weeks.
natalie: SLA implications: need per-tenant p95 budget in rollout config and a fast rollback lane that flips traffic back to runtime if latency delta > 25% or semantic-diff > 0.2%.
ops-bot: infra: canary cluster provisioned for placement-service (2 nodes). Dashboards created for p95, semantic-diff, 5xx.
samir: Rollout sketch:
1) deploy placement-service behind shim; runtime consults shim ReadHint
2) enable 100% mirror for 48h and run semantic diffs (tolerance: ordering only)
3) ramp traffic 1% -> 10% -> 50% with smoke gates
4) flip authoritative writes to placement-service for chosen tenants; keep safe-slab fallback for 30d
frances: Dev ergonomics: need a local profile to run runtime+placement+lite-cache and a script to seed placement mappings for hot tenants. Also update SDK to propagate new route header.
kai: Data concerns: export small mapping snapshots for top-100 tenants to avoid cold-thrashing. We'll provide an inject script for placement cache.
natalie: Observability: add per-tenant rollout card in console, show billing-preview, semantic-diff rate, p95 delta, and fallback-count. Product will add an opt-out button per tenant.
samir: Tech-debt policy: mark runtime endpoints deprecated after 90 days with zero write traffic and an audit entry; prune code after 120 days of no fallbacks.
frances: Action items:
- Kai: placement API + ReadHint contract PR (ETA 4d)
- Natalie: rollout config + SLA thresholds (ETA 3d)
- Ops: seed-inject script + canary monitor tweaks (ETA 5d)
- Samir: migration runbook + pruning policy doc (ETA 6d)
I'll book a 30-min sync in 48h to review PRs.
